dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Collei! Sucrose! I brought some home-cooked food, why don't we enjoy it together?

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: I—I must point out a small issue about your cooking! You have a tendency to put a little too much flavoring in your dishes...

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Ahahaha, sorry! I guess I've been a little heavy-handed with the seasonings lately...

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: Are you feeling stressed recently? Do you want to find someone to play cards with? It really helps with stress, I promise!

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: Oh, that sounds like a good idea. If I recall, both you and Sucrose are pretty good players, right?

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: Oh yeah, we are! We've been playing together, and we were actually talking about this just a few days ago...

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: Since you are already familiar... would you mind also showing me the rules sometime?

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Yeah, Collei seems to be a natural at the game... Maybe she's already the best player out of all of us!

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: That's right, you've been all the talk at the tavern. "That little girl from Sumeru is really good at the game... If I can find the chance, I would love to test my skills against her."

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: Isn't that great, Collei? You've become a TCG celebrity!
